question: 新实际装机与LCOE部署路径下，全球风光发电、损失和极端暴露如何随年变化？
future: Four-GCM mean; 2026-2029 fixed GEM2025; 2030-2059 cumulative LCOE snapshots
weights: Capacity weighted; common valid support within phase, technology and pathway across years and models
uncertainty: Four-model min/max in source tables; no confidence interval or significance claim
connection: Future lines start at historical 2025 endpoint; no shift of computed future values
exports: 17 full PNGs and 51 independent panels, 600 dpi

fixed_capacity_family.question: 固定2025年装机后，不同气候SSP路径下损失、发电量、极端暴露和CF如何变化？
fixed_capacity_family.metrics: Same as the main family except installed capacity; loss, generation, exposure, CF
fixed_capacity_family.capacity: 2025 year-end GEM catalogue capacity for 2026-2059, identical to the transition phase
fixed_capacity_family.future_support: Per-station values from the paired station-SSP future archives at grids overlapping GEM2025 (all GEM grids are inside every LCOE layout); unit energies divided by archive capacity and re-weighted at fixed capacity
fixed_capacity_family.valid_support: Intersection of transition and future common support, fixed across 2026-2059 within each pathway, model and technology

generation_interpretation: Annual climate-driven estimate using each year-end capacity for the full year; no intra-year commissioning adjustment
